census<N>: Holds census-derived observations (one row per observed location × statistic × year/frequency) with keys like source_desc, commodity_desc, location_desc, year, agg_level_desc, state_ansi, county_ansi and measures value and cv_percent (also begin_code/end_code, reference_period_desc, week_ending, load_time).
crops: Contains crop-related observations (one row per observed location × crop statistic × year/frequency) identified by source_desc, commodity_desc, short_desc, location_desc, year, agg_level_desc, state_ansi, county_ansi and measures value, value_suppression_code and cv_percent (plus time fields begin_code/end_code, reference_period_desc, week_ending, load_time).
animals_products: Stores animal- and product-related observations (one row per observed location × animal/product statistic × year/frequency) keyed by source_desc, commodity_desc, short_desc, location_desc, year, agg_level_desc, state_ansi, county_ansi with measures value and cv_percent (includes begin_code/end_code, reference_period_desc, week_ending, load_time).
census_<N>: Another census table holding census-derived observations (one row per observed location × statistic × year/frequency) with columns source_desc, commodity_desc, location_desc, year, agg_level_desc, state_ansi, county_ansi and measures value, value_suppression_code, cv_percent plus time metadata (begin_code/end_code, reference_period_desc, week_ending, load_time).
environmental: Contains environmental observations (one row per observed location × environmental statistic × year/frequency) identified by source_desc, commodity_desc, short_desc, location_desc, year, agg_level_desc, state_ansi, county_ansi with measures value, value_suppression_code and cv_percent and time fields (begin_code/end_code, reference_period_desc, week_ending, load_time).
economics: Holds economic observations (one row per observed location × economic statistic × year/frequency) keyed by source_desc, commodity_desc, short_desc, location_desc, year, agg_level_desc, state_ansi, county_ansi with measures value and cv_percent (includes begin_code/end_code, reference_period_desc, week_ending, load_time).
demographics: Stores demographic observations (one row per observed location × demographic statistic × year/frequency) with source_desc, commodity_desc, short_desc, location_desc, year, agg_level_desc, state_ansi, county_ansi as keys and measures value and cv_percent plus time metadata (begin_code/end_code, reference_period_desc, week_ending, load_time).
